'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Thomas Whaley LS Republic At War''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Republic At War / A Precarious Predicament (V)|VB9-L-republicatwar-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
